description: Cs₂Na₃TlO₄ is alpha Pu-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Cs sites. In the first Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one O atom. The Cs-O bond length is 2.99 Å. In the second Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Cs-O bond distances ranging from 3.17-3.52 Å. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TlO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one TlO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.46 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TlO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one TlO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.53 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TlO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one TlO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.42 Å. Tl is bonded to four O atoms to form TlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with three NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Tl-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.26 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Cs, four Na, and one Tl atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Cs, three Na, and one Tl atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Cs, two Na, and one Tl atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Cs, three Na, and one Tl atom.
